title: Wide Field Coverage for Juno (WFCJ): Hubble WFC3 and Gemini North NIRI maps of Jupiter, 2016–2019

evidence.locator: Data file types: _mosaic.fits, map (cylindrical projection) of Gemini NIRI data, a mosaic of many exposures, corrected for limb darkening; longitudinal domain may be global or sub-global. Citations: cite Wong et al. (2020) and the DOI; these products are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
